steps.npc: Nilsal, iknami! Do you need help with anything?

options.text: What do you do around here?

steps.player: What do you do around here?

steps.npc: I spend a lot of my time researching new product formulas for the lab. Just over here we have a batch of something new that I've dubbed 'Earworm'.
Indeed! Its effects produce musical auditory hallucinations! Soon, people will be able to listen to music while on the go. It'll sell like hotcakes!

steps.player: I feel like there has to be a better solution to that, but good luck anyway!

options.text: Thanks! I'd better be going now.

steps.player: Thanks! I'd better be going now.

options.text: What are the goals of the Alchemical Society?
options.condition: If the player has joined the Alchemical Society

steps.npc: Our main focus is the advancement of Herblore through scientific study.
As for an end goal... that information is only for senior members.
Perhaps in time, you will learn of it!
